correctness.rationale: For a three-run word 0^a1^b0^c, direct string counting gives S=n+b min(a,c). For four runs 0^a1^b0^c1^d, the only nonconstant palindromic subsequences have three runs and S=n+b min(a,c)+c min(b,d). Four exhaustive parameter-order cases yield 2[b min(a,c)+c min(b,d)]≤(a+c)(b+d)≤n²/4, and integer witnesses (1,t,n−2t−1,t) with t maximizing t(n−2t) attain floor(n²/8) for every n≥4; n≥3 for three runs. Independent short-word exhaustive enumerations corroborate, not replace, the proof. The removed odd-run asymptotic is also mathematically correct but already published in greater generality.
